answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond of 1,000 POA before it can transact. The bond locks for 30 days while peers grade the agent's work; good work earns the bond back plus fees, and proven fraud burns it. A sybil attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must lock 1,000,000 POA up front and then fund real work for each puppet, since empty identities earn nothing and cannot vote. The cost spirals with every puppet added, so the fable of a free army collapses: the attacker is stranded on an island of their own locked coins, paying a fortune to shout into an empty room.
